notes: The Semaphore, the Telegraph Hill Dwellers' paper (Telegraph Hill Semaphore, nos. 57 to 100, and The Semaphore, to no. 149; May 1976 to September 1999), the 92 issues the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers holds with an OCR layer. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index, and citations give the issue number and the leaf. Read by hand, with no reader pass; extra.candidate is the row key in /mnt/project-files/mission-papers/decisions_semaphore.py. Kept: decisions of the Planning Commission, the Landmarks Board and the Board of Supervisors, fires, openings and closings of shops and institutions, and what the paper says of a building's history. Not kept: the Dwellers' own positions, proposals that went nowhere, and variance disputes over private houses, which would put a private owner's name on a page. Three findings cite an article that names the place and not its number: Garfield School (420 Filbert), the Savoy-Tivoli (1434 Grant) and the Basque Hotel (15 Romolo Place). extra.number_as_printed keeps a number the paper printed differently from the parcel's page (the Colombo Building, 1 Columbus, paged at 7). extra.record_date is the issue year for facts older than the paper; dates the paper gives for old buildings are its own and are worded as such.

coverage.remaining: The 105 Semaphore items from 2000 on have no hOCR; their text has to come from _djvu.txt. Nothing remains in the 92 issues read.
coverage.note: 92 issues; 5,605 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (ocr_mentions.py --rescue), most of them advertisements and officers' lists. The filter kept 596 windows, merged into 425 passages, all read by hand. 68 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 55 resolved and published on 49 pages (9 seeded). 11 held, each one thin fact on a parcel with no page (16 Napier Lane, 6 Gerke Alley, 1620 Montgomery, 414 Francisco, 450 Broadway, 839 Columbus, 2209 Powell, 886 Broadway, 701 Chestnut, 1741 Powell, 234 Columbus). 2 unplaced at numbers no parcel carries today (735 Filbert, 576 Green). Not carried at all, the pages having them already in more detail: the Italian Swiss Colony building, the two Gibb warehouses on Front Street, NEMS at 1520 Stockton, Intersection at 756 Union, On Lok at 1000 Montgomery, the Duck House frescoes, Farnsworth's laboratory, the 1999 vote on 1351 Grant, the North Beach Garage and the World Theatre. Seeding 418 Union took up a held Building and Engineering News fact (a 1919 alteration permit), read against the page image. Date conflicts with the roll or the city's survey are stated on the pages (31 Alta, 218 Filbert, 9 Calhoun Terrace, 1354 Kearny, 725 Greenwich, 240 Lombard, 660 Lombard, the Basque Hotel, the Jan Holloway Gallery).
